statement: PutRole is analyzed per permission, what cannot be proved contained needs an approval, and adding a permission needs cosec:grant.
guards: control:RolesTest#a star role put with the catalog that defines its permissions is asked cosec grant for
control:RolesTest#a catalog that gives a star role a binding it did not derive is asked cosec grant for
control:RolesTest#a hand-written permission that gives a star role a binding is asked cosec grant for
